question: Does the exact merged implementation preserve the invariant that a spawned child can inherit every concrete tool visible to its parent, but never a tool removed by any final parent authorization or compatibility layer?
rationale: The patch appears correct and well tested, but it deliberately changes tool availability across a security boundary established by prior MCP/LSP policy hardening, so final acceptance requires owner intent rather than automated judgment alone.

options.title: Approve final-surface inheritance
options.body: Refresh onto current main, verify the exact merge result retains all final filters, and land the concrete-name implementation.

options.title: Require explicit immutable handoff
options.body: Replace the shared mutable cap with an explicit final effective-surface result if the owner considers lifecycle mutation too difficult to audit.
